text:
natalie: quick sync 1 - need final GA gating for micro-pools + burst policy. we promised clearer comms to a few pilots.
oscar: are we shipping per-tenant micro-pools at GA or starting with pool-level lanes?
anya: runtime: per-tenant micro-pools add KV warmup and scheduling complexity. recommend pool-level micro-lanes at GA, per-tenant pools GA+1.
mike: infra: agree. pool-level lanes reduce quota bookkeeping. also cheaper to test load shaping.
sara: cs/sales: pilots (Northstar + Beacon) want deterministic tail behavior during launches. they asked for preview of throttling signals and a manual override path.
natalie: proposal for GA: ship micro-lanes + soft-burst multiplier (3x) + manual "temporary headroom" request flow (CS gate). defer per-tenant reservation & billing to GA+1.
oscar: what about autoscale defaults? small burst + faster scale-up, long cooldown to avoid flapping?
anya: suggested defaults: scale_up 1.6x/min, scale_down cooldown 15m. add circuit-breaker: if 95p > 2.5x for 5m, shrink multiplier to 1.2 and route opportunistic to pinned.
mike: config snippet that infra will implement:
```
autoscale:
  scale_up_rate: 1.6
  scale_down_cooldown_s: 900
burst:
  pool_soft_multiplier: 3
  opt_in_manual_headroom_minutes: 30
```
sara: manual override flow: CS creates temporary headroom ticket, ops approves, system flips pool flag for 30m and emits notice to tenant console. need template.
natalie: observability gating: GA must include per-pool token meter, 95/99p latency, KV-miss-rate, and an audit log for manual headroom toggles. if any of those are missing, we delay default-on.
oscar: what about customer-facing wording? sara, can you draft a short blurb: "Soft-burst is a short-duration buffer; sustained needs require reserved headroom."
sara: will do. also will add a one-paragraph playbook for pilots: request steps, expected approvals, and rollback criteria.
anya: safety tweak: add a prewarm window heuristic: only allow opportunistic spill for first 4 minutes after autoscale event unless KV warm metric shows steady hit-rate. that limits long tails.
mike: timeline: micro-lanes + autoscale + telemetry + manual headroom toggle = 1 sprint. circuit-breaker + prewarm heuristics + audit logs = next sprint.
ops-bot: ticket CREATED: PROD-7900 "Dedicated: micro-lanes GA gating + manual headroom flow" assigned to @mike
deploy-bot: subtask CREATED: RUNTIME-341 "circuit-breaker and KV warm heuristics" assigned to @anya
natalie: decision: ship micro-lanes + soft-burst + manual headroom for pilots at GA; defer per-tenant pools and billing automation to GA+1. owners: mike (infra), anya (runtime), sara (customer comms). all thumbs?
oscar: thumbs up.
anya: thumbs up.
mike: thumbs up.
sara: thumbs up, drafting comms now.
natalie: thanks. i'll update roadmap and post GA gating note. follow-up sync 10am PT tomorrow. :calendar:
